lines.en: label beachmas16:
scene clearnightsky
This is where a poetic interjection would go if my mind was not currently occupied by other things.
lines.zh: 若不是此刻脑子里装着别的事，这里本该来上一段诗意的抒情。

lines.en: You see, the beach for me has always been a relaxing place. Not a place I particularly {i}like,{/i} but one where I can kick back and watch the holes in the atmosphere be gradually filled in.
lines.zh: 你要知道，海滩对我来说一直是个能让人放松的地方。谈不上多{i}喜欢{/i}，但至少能让我躺下来，看着大气层上的那些空洞被一点点填满。

lines.en: The last two days have felt a lot more like dental surgery.
lines.zh: 而这两天，感觉倒更像是在做牙科手术。

lines.en: Like the sky is the roof of my mouth and the surgeon keeps slipping — jabbing me repeatedly with an electric drill and draining the blood from out of my gums.
lines.zh: 天空就像我的上颚，而那个外科医生的手一直在滑——拿着电钻反复戳我，把血从我牙龈里一点点抽干。

lines.en: This isn’t what I wanted.
lines.zh: 这不是我想要的。

lines.en: I wanted {i}peace.{/i}
lines.zh: 我想要的是{i}平静{/i}。

lines.en: But it doesn’t matter what I want, because I am not the protagonist of this game.
lines.zh: 可我要什么并不重要，因为我不是这游戏的主角。

lines.en: I’m just an accompaniment.
lines.zh: 我只是个陪衬。

lines.en: Another hole in the atmosphere.
lines.zh: 大气层上又一个洞。

lines.en: And I’ll have to accept that not every outing like this will always serve to connect the dots.
lines.zh: 而我也只能接受：并不是每一次这样的出游，都能把点与点连起来。

lines.en: Sometimes, you can’t help but leave the beach with burns.
lines.zh: 有时候，你只能带着烧伤离开海滩。

lines.en: This summer is just far too hot.
lines.zh: 这个夏天实在太热了。

lines.en: Enjoy your night.
lines.zh: 好好享受这个夜晚吧。

lines.en: It will be a long one.
lines.zh: 它会很漫长。

lines.en: scene proxy1
: Okay, Io. This is the part where you talk about how I’m the best friend in the world for walking away from Niki’s Christmas concert just so you can be happy. Because I really wanted to see that.
lines.zh: : 好了，Io。现在该你说我是全世界最好的朋友了——我可是为了让你开心，才从 Niki 的圣诞演唱会现场走掉的。因为我真的超想看那场的。

lines.en: : Uta, you’re the best friend in the world. But why would you ever want to spend more than thirty seconds listening to that happy-go-lucky bubblegum pop music when we could be...you know...{i}not{/i} doing that?
lines.zh: : Uta，你是全世界最好的朋友。可我们明明可以……你知道的……{i}不做{/i}那件事，你为什么还想花超过三十秒去听那种没心没肺的泡泡糖流行乐？

lines.en: : Uhh...because I like that happy-go-lucky bubblegum pop music? How come you spend so much time carving away at wood when you could be helping out at the cafe?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为我就是喜欢那种没心没肺的泡泡糖流行乐啊？那你有那么多时间，为什么不去咖啡厅帮忙，非要在这儿雕木头？

lines.en: : I work for myself — not the culturally exaggerated tourist traps that serve as the lifeblood to all of Japan.
lines.zh: : 我为自己工作——而不是为那些被文化吹捧起来的旅游陷阱，那玩意儿可是全日本的命脉。

lines.en: : Kumon-mi’s been closed for years. We don’t even have any tourists. It’s just a bunch of lesbians, girls who used to go to our old school, and Sensei who come to the cafe.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 都关了好几年了。我们连游客都没有。来咖啡厅的就只有一群女同性恋、以前我们学校的女生，还有老师。

lines.en: : I see now why he spends so much time there. Throw in a couple hypersexual blondes who talk too much and you’d have his exact clientèle.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白他为什么老往那儿跑了。再加上几个话多得要命的性感金发妞，就是他的标准客户群了。

lines.en: scene proxy2
: Those are my friends, Io.
lines.zh: : 那都是我的朋友，Io。

lines.en: : Hm? But I didn’t even say anything mean about them this time.
lines.zh: : 嗯？可我这回根本没说她们什么难听话啊。

lines.en: : No, but you were thinking it and your tone was rude.
lines.zh: : 是没说，但你心里在想，而且语气很冲。

lines.en: : I’m pretty much always thinking rude things. That’s what I do. But I’ve gotten better at keeping that kind of stuff to myself lately, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 我脑子里基本随时都在转些刻薄念头。这就是我。不过最近我越来越能把那些话憋在心里了，不是吗？

lines.en: : That...depends on what you brought me out here to talk about tonight.
lines.zh: : 那……得看你今晚找我出来是要谈什么。

lines.en: : You said you had something you wanted to tell me, and I kinda just assumed it was gonna be more complaints about all of the people who aren’t you that are also vying for Sensei’s affection.
lines.zh: : 你说有话要告诉我，我还以为又要听你抱怨那些不是你、却也在跟老师争宠的人。

lines.en: scene proxy3
: That’s a fair assumption. Complaining about the people I’m wrongfully jealous of despite vehemently hating  is pretty on-brand for me. But that’s not what I wanted to talk about today.
lines.zh: : 这推测挺合理。抱怨那些我恨得要死、却还无理地嫉妒着的人，确实很符合我的风格。但今天我想说的不是这个。

lines.en: : There’s a thing that happened a while ago that I never told you about and it’s been kind of eating at me. So I wanted to get your thoughts on it and hear what you think I should do.
lines.zh: : 有件事是很久以前发生的，我一直没告诉过你，它一直在我心里啃。所以我想听听你的想法，你觉得我该怎么办。

lines.en: : That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: scene proxy4
: There’s...actually something that happened to me too. And I probably should have told you earlier since we promised to not keep that kind of stuff secret, but...you know how I am.
lines.zh: : 其实……我也遇到了一件事。我们说好这种事不瞒着对方的，我本该早点告诉你，但……你知道我什么德行。

lines.en: : Of course. I know you better than anybody.
lines.zh: : 当然。我比任何人都了解你。

lines.en: scene proxy5
: How about this? Let’s go take a seat under those palm trees over there and spill our hearts out to one another chatroom style. Just like we used to in the old days.
lines.zh: : 这样吧？我们去那边那几棵棕榈树下坐着，像以前在聊天室里那样，把心里话都倒出来。就跟从前一样。

lines.en: : You mean when we thought each other had penises?
lines.zh: : 你是说我们都以为对方有鸡巴的那时候？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s been a while since we’ve really talked like that, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 对。我们已经很久没那样好好聊过了吧？

lines.en: : Probably a whole year. Most recent time I remember is when we did...basically the same thing last time we came to the beach. Just with an added layer of Yasu bein’ all creepy.
lines.zh: : 大概整整一年了。我记得最近一次还是上次来海边的时候，基本做了同样的事，只不过多了 Yasu 在旁边变态兮兮地搅局。

lines.en: : That didn’t count. That was pretty much all about me. We’ll {i}both{/i} get a turn today. And we’ll do it in a way that’s 100%% judgement free.
lines.zh: : 那次不算。那次基本全是在说我。今天咱们{i}俩都{/i}轮一次。而且全程 100%% 不带评判。

lines.en: : You can even pretend I have a penis again if that makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 你要是高兴，甚至可以再把我当成有鸡巴的那个。

lines.en: scene proxy6
: Cool?
: Not with that part. Girl Io is the one I care about now.
lines.zh: : 就那部分不行。我现在在乎的是女生版的 Io。

lines.en: : Besides, now that I know you, I feel like boy Io would have a really small penis and it would just make me laugh any time I think of it.
lines.zh: : 再说了，现在认识你了，我觉得男生版的 Io 鸡巴肯定特别小，每次一想起来我就会笑。

lines.en: : Boy Io is offended. Girl Io doesn’t care. But both Ios think it’s time for the two of us to relive what brought us together in the first place.
lines.zh: : 男生版 Io 受到了冒犯。女生版 Io 无所谓。但两个 Io 都觉得，是时候让我们重温一下当初把彼此连在一起的那个东西了。

lines.en: : If that’s not cool, we can go back inside and listen to your stupid pop idol sing songs about cake or...candy or whatever it is idols sing about. I normally just tune it out.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得不行，我们就回屋里去，听你那个蠢流行偶像唱蛋糕啊……糖果啊，随便偶像都唱些什么。我平时都是直接屏蔽掉的。

lines.en: : Okay...but the next time {i}I{/i} want to talk to {i}you{/i} in a situation I’m not comfortable in, you have to come along no questions asked.
lines.zh: : 好……但下次{i}我{/i}要在让我不自在的场合找{i}你{/i}说话，你二话不说也得陪我来。

lines.en: : Uta, are you forgetting who you’re talking to? Literally every situation outside of my bedroom makes me uncomfortable. I’ll come with you no matter what.
lines.zh: : Uta，你忘了你在跟谁说话吗？除了我的卧室，这世上几乎所有场合都让我不自在。不管去哪我都陪你。

lines.en: : Promise?
lines.zh: : 说定了？

lines.en: : Promise.
lines.zh: : 说定了。

lines.en: scene black
scene proxy7
: {i}Io has logged in.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Io 已上线。{/i}

lines.en: : We’re not really going to do it like that, are we?
lines.zh: : 我们不会真要这么聊吧？

lines.en: : No. I’m just being awkward. We can talk slowly and succinctly- like the deeply traumatized teenage girls we are!
lines.zh: : 不会。我只是有点犯尴尬。我们可以慢慢地、简明扼要地聊——就像我们这种深度受创的少女该有的样子！

lines.en: : Yippee...hooray for scars that never fade.
lines.zh: : 好耶……为那些永不褪色的伤疤干杯。

lines.en: : And hooray for safe spaces that protect people like us from further exploitation! I now open the floor to you, Uta.
lines.zh: : 也为那些保护我们这种人不再被剥削的安全区干杯！现在把发言权交给你，Uta。

lines.en: scene proxy8
: I’m going first?
lines.zh: : 我先说？

lines.en: : Yeah. Because if I go first, I’ll get too absorbed in the sound of my own voice and just ramble on until morning comes- and I want to make sure you’re actually able to get stuff off your oversized chest tonight.
lines.zh: : 对。因为要是我先说，我会沉迷在自己的声音里，一路絮叨到天亮——我得确保你今晚真的能把心里那堆东西从你那过大的胸口里倒出来。

lines.en: scene proxy9
: Oversized, it is not. I am quite the proportional creature, Io. And I am proud of the body my parents gave me.
lines.zh: : 才没有过大。我这身材可是相当匀称的，Io。我为自己父母给的这副身体感到骄傲。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because it makes you money at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为它能在女仆咖啡厅帮你赚钱。

lines.en: : Sometimes, you must submerge yourself in the well of obscenity if you are ever going to emerge wet with confidence.
lines.zh: : 有时候，你必须把自己沉进那口污秽之井，才能浑身湿漉漉地带着自信浮上来。

lines.en: : Is that line a leftover from the Dorm Wars?
lines.zh: : 这句是 Dorm Wars 时期留下来的吧？

lines.en: : Kunoichi Uta isn’t gone. Her story lives on forever.
lines.zh: : 女忍者 Uta 从未消失。她的故事永世流传。

lines.en: : What’s going on, Uta? What did you want to tell me?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Uta？你想跟我说什么？

lines.en: scene proxy10
: Let out as much as you can, but stop if you get too uncomfortable. Just like they taught us.
lines.zh: : 能说多少说多少，太难受了就停下。就像他们教我们的那样。

lines.en: : I was always too uncomfortable. I only ever said anything because I felt like I had to.
lines.zh: : 我一直都很不舒服。我之所以会说出口，从来只是因为觉得自己非说不可。

lines.en: : But think about where you’d be right now if you never did.
lines.zh: : 可你想想，要是你当初什么都没说，你现在会在哪儿。
: 那事……

lines.en: : It happened again.
lines.zh: : 又发生了。

lines.en: scene proxy11
: {i}What{/i} happened?
lines.zh: : 发生了{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : The other day...Well, I guess it’s more like the other {i}month{/i} at this point...I was about to take a bath...and my phone went off.
lines.zh: : 那天……嗯，现在想想其实都过去{i}一个多月{/i}了……我正准备洗澡……然后手机响了。

lines.en: : So, I went to go look and...
lines.zh: : 我就过去看了一眼，然后……

lines.en: scene proxy12
: {i}Hooooo...{/i}
: It’s okay. You’re fine.
lines.zh: : 没事了。你没事的。

lines.en: scene proxy13
: It was...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Somebody sent me...a picture...of myself.
lines.zh: : 有人给我发了一张……我自己的……照片。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to tell you...what kind.
lines.zh: : 我想我不用告诉你……是哪种照片。

lines.en: : Do you know who did it?
lines.zh: : 你知道是谁发的吗？

lines.en: : I looked up the number, but it was...one of those disposable online ones...
lines.zh: : 我查了那个号码，但那是……那种一次性的网络号码……

lines.en: scene proxy14
: I fucking hate everyone. How is this still happening so many years later? Like, seriously. Get a fucking life, assholes.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨死所有人了。都这么多年了，怎么还在发生这种事？说真的，你们这些人能不能去他妈的找点事做，混蛋。

lines.en: : It’s going to follow me forever, Io. Every time I think it’s over and start to forget, I get blindsided by the stupid things I did when I was a kid and it just...
lines.zh: : 它会跟着我一辈子的，Io。每次我以为结束了、开始忘记的时候，就会被自己小时候干的那些蠢事打个措手不及，然后就……

lines.en: : It never ends.
lines.zh: : 永远没完。

lines.en: : My phone’s not even supposed to {i}get{/i} picture messages. We had them blocked for this exact reason.
lines.zh: : 我的手机本来就{i}收不了{/i}彩信。我们就是因为这个才把它们屏蔽掉的。

lines.en: : Yet, someone always finds them...
lines.zh: : 可总有人能找到它们……

lines.en: : And always finds {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也总能找到{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Can I not just disappear? Do I have to change my name? Will that help? Or will they find that too?
lines.zh: : 我就不能干脆消失掉吗？我是不是得改名字？那有用吗？还是说他们照样能查到？

lines.en: : I don’t even {i}know{/i} how many phone numbers and email addresses I’ve gone through at this point. It’s all hopeless.
lines.zh: : 我都{i}记不清{/i}自己到现在换过多少个手机号和邮箱了。全都没用。

lines.en: : And it’s not even the being doxxed part that scares me the most anymore. It’s everyone else finding out about it.
lines.zh: : 而且现在最让我害怕的，甚至已经不是被人肉本身。而是被其他人知道。

lines.en: : I like my life here. And not only that, but I don’t even have the option to go anywhere else now if things get out.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我在这里的生活。而且不仅如此，万一事情传出去，我现在连别的地方都去不了。

lines.en: : If news spreads that there are naked pictures of me from before I was even in middle school floating around the Internet, no one’s gonna see me as {i}me{/i} anymore. They’re gonna see {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 要是传出网上有我上中学之前的裸照在流传，就再也不会有人把我当{i}我{/i}了。他们只会看到{i}那个东西{/i}。

lines.en: : And even the ones who like me enough to try and look past it...how am I supposed to look at {i}them{/i} knowing that {i}they{/i} know?
lines.zh: : 就算是那些喜欢我、愿意试着看开一点的人……我又该怎么面对{i}他们{/i}，明知{i}他们{/i}已经知道了？

lines.en: scene proxy15
: It’s just so fucking embarrassing! And it makes me feel absolutely disgusting every time I remember it since I never thought I was doing anything wrong in the first place!
lines.zh: : 这实在太他妈丢人了！而且每次想起来都让我觉得自己恶心至极，因为我从头到尾都没觉得自己做错了什么！

lines.en: : I just wanted to feel pretty! Everyone always talked about how boyish I was and...someone finally didn’t do that and I thought I could trust them, but-
lines.zh: : 我只是想觉得自己漂亮！所有人都老说我像个男孩子，然后……终于有个人不这么说了，我以为我可以相信他，可——

lines.en: : This is going to sound extremely hypocritical given the person I’m currently infatuated with, but people are fucking sick, Uta. Never trust anyone.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我现在迷恋的是谁，这话从我嘴里说出来大概虚伪透顶，但人就是他妈有病，Uta。永远别相信任何人。

lines.en: scene proxy16
: Io, what should I do if people find out? How would I ever be able to face anyone after that?
lines.zh: : Io，要是被人知道了怎么办？那之后我还怎么有脸见人？

lines.en: : I don’t know...but I really wish I did. Because there’s no one out there who deserves a life free of all of that bullshit more than you do.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……但我真的希望我知道。因为这世上再没有谁比你更配得上那种不被狗屁倒灶的事沾染的生活了。

lines.en: : And if we ever find out who it is, you can bet your ass that I’ll be joining your brother in jail.
lines.zh: : 而且要是真查出是谁干的，你放心，我绝对会进去陪你哥蹲号子。

lines.en: scene proxy17
: Pfft...thanks. I’m pretty sure they keep the boys and girls separate though.
lines.zh: : 噗……谢了。不过我猜男女是分开关的吧。

lines.en: : I know. And the fact that I’d be willing to deal with an entire correctional facility’s worth of unruly women should show you just how important you are to me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。而我能为了你忍受一整座监狱里那些难搞的女人，这总该让你看清你对我有多重要了吧。

lines.en: : I already knew that...and I wouldn’t want anyone else sacrificing their freedom for my sake anyway.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道了……而且我也不想让任何人为了我牺牲自由。

lines.en: : Just having somebody to talk to is enough for now. Especially someone like you...who I know won’t look at me any differently for things that have happened in the past.
lines.zh: : 现在有个人能听我说这些就够了。尤其是像你这样的人……我知道你不会因为过去发生的事就用异样的眼光看我。

lines.en: : Being able to look past that is the only thing that keeps me together. You know that.
lines.zh: : 能把那些看开，是唯一让我不至于散架的东西。你知道的。

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: scene proxy18
: Okay. Uta is no longer typing. That means it’s your turn to enter the judgement free trauma zone.
lines.zh: : 好了。Uta 已停止输入。现在轮到你进入这个无评判创伤区了。

lines.en: : Uhh...I feel kind of weird going now since your thing was way worse than mine and mine was probably just me overreacting.
lines.zh: : 呃……现在轮到我，感觉有点奇怪，毕竟你那件事比我严重多了，我这个大概只是我反应过度。

lines.en: : I don’t care. If it’s something you want to talk about, I want to hear it. You said you wanted my advice anyway, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。只要是你想说的，我就想听。你不是说想听我的建议吗？

lines.en: scene proxy19
: Yeah...I do. But it’s less like {i}wanting{/i} your advice and more like {i}needing{/i} it since I’ve kind of sworn away all thoughts on the subject already.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我是想听。但与其说是{i}想要{/i}你的建议，不如说是{i}需要{/i}，因为关于这件事，我已经把所有念头都自我禁止了。

lines.en: : I...don’t like the sound of that.
lines.zh: : 我……不太喜欢这个说法。

lines.en: : So, like...uh...
lines.zh: : 那么，就是……呃……

lines.en: : Remember when I asked you for Sensei’s address a while ago?
lines.zh: : 还记得我之前问你要老师的地址吗？

lines.en: scene proxy20
: Mhm...
: Well, it goes without saying that I went over to his place after that. And it was fun! A lot of fun!
lines.zh: : 不用说，那之后我就去他家了。而且很开心！超级开心！

lines.en: : Mhm.
: But, uhh...
lines.zh: : 但是，呃……

lines.en: : It kind of...{i}stopped{/i} being fun when we got to a certain point that I...{i}definitely{/i} enabled due to my never ending need to try and make him like me.
lines.zh: : 到了某个节点，就……{i}不那么开心{/i}了。而这个节点说到底是{i}我自己促成{/i}的，因为我总有那种想让他喜欢我的、没完没了的需求。

lines.en: : But I guess I...wanted him to like me {i}differently?{/i} Without, like...you know...sexual...contact?
lines.zh: : 但我大概是……希望他用{i}别的{/i}方式喜欢我？不带……你知道的……性……接触？

lines.en: scene proxy21
: You didn’t-
lines.zh: : 你没——

lines.en: : Nonononono. No way. No, I fucking booked it. But it was {i}my{/i} fault he got the wrong idea since I’m the one who got into bed first, you know?
lines.zh: : 不不不不不。没有。绝对没有。我他妈撒腿就跑了。但他会误会也是{i}我{/i}的错，毕竟是我先钻进被窝的，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Sensei is...well, very driven by a certain set of...uhh...{i}feelings{/i} I can’t really reciprocate. As I’m sure you...already know.
lines.zh: : 老师他……嗯，是被某一种……呃……我实在无法回应的……{i}感觉{/i}所驱动着的。这点你……肯定已经知道了。

lines.en: : What...happened?
lines.zh: : 那……发生了什么？

lines.en: : Nothing! Really! He just...got kind of {i}handsy{/i} when we were cuddling and...I couldn’t take it anymore. Because I’m a coward.
lines.zh: : 什么都没发生！真的！他只是……我们抱着抱着的，他就开始{i}动手动脚{/i}，然后……我再也受不了了。因为我是个胆小鬼。

lines.en: scene proxy22
: You’re not a coward, Io. That is the {i}last{/i} thing you should be calling yourself in a situation like that.
lines.zh: : 你不是胆小鬼，Io。这种情况下，你{i}最不该{/i}这么称呼自己。

lines.en: : If anything, you’re brave for doing what you did since you always knew there was the possibility of something like that happening, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 要说的话，你做了那种事反而说明你很勇敢——因为你心里一直清楚，这种事是有可能发生的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Does it...uhh...count if I was in denial about it?
lines.zh: : 如果……呃……我之前一直在自我否认呢，还算吗？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 我觉得算。

lines.en: : I see...cool. Nice.
lines.zh: : 这样啊……不错。挺好。

lines.en: : We haven’t really...talked about it since then, so...I don’t think Sensei is {i}too{/i} mad. Or, if he is, he’s keeping it to himself and waiting for me to lose interest or something. Which I won’t. Because brain.
lines.zh: : 从那以后我们基本……没再提过，所以……我觉得老师{i}没那么{/i}生气。就算生气，他也只是闷在心里，等我自己没了兴趣之类的。而我不会的。因为脑子。

lines.en: scene proxy23
: I doubt he’s mad, but...how did you run away exactly? What did you say to him?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得他在生气，不过……你具体是怎么跑掉的？你跟他说了什么？

lines.en: : I think I told him that I had work or something. I don’t know. It all happened really fast and I had to hide under the bridge near his house so I could throw up a few times. It’s all one big blur.
lines.zh: : 我好像是跟他说我还有工作要做之类的。我也不知道。一切都发生得太快了，我还得躲到他家附近那座桥底下吐了好几次。整件事糊成一团。
: Io……

lines.en: : But, like...he {i}needs{/i} that sort of relationship with somebody. And I’ve given him so many signs that I {i}can’t{/i} do that and he just...he doesn’t really {i}get{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 但就是……他{i}需要{/i}有人给他那种关系。而我已经给了他那么多暗示，表明我{i}做不到{/i}，可他就是……不太{i}明白{/i}。

lines.en: : So that’s the part where your advice is needed...what am I supposed to do from this point on?
lines.zh: : 所以这就是需要你给建议的地方了……从现在起我该怎么办？

lines.en: : We’re at the stage where we’re close enough {i}to{/i} do that by normal standards, but my standards are anything but normal and delaying any longer might make him hate me.
lines.zh: : 按正常标准，我们已经亲密到{i}可以{/i}做那种事了，可我的标准一点也不正常，再拖下去他可能会恨我。

lines.en: : Why don’t you just...tell him? He’ll understand.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不干脆……告诉他？他会理解的。

lines.en: scene proxy24
: {i}Understand?{/i}

: Not only will he not {i}understand,{/i} he’ll be {i}repulsed.{/i} I’m already infinitely unlikable with all of my broken pieces. The last thing I need is for the most {i}broken{/i} of them to stick out and shine.
lines.zh: : 他不但不会{i}理解{/i}，还会觉得我{i}恶心{/i}。我本来就带着一身破碎的零件，已经够讨人嫌了。我最不需要的，就是让其中{i}最碎{/i}的那一块凸出来、闪闪发亮。

lines.en: : It’s like your thing. You don’t want anyone to know and neither do I because we want things to stay the way they are.
lines.zh: : 就像你那件事。你不想让任何人知道，我也不想，因为我们都希望一切维持原样。

lines.en: : I know, Io...but I’m not in love with my entire class. And you-
lines.zh: : 我知道，Io……可我又不是爱上了全班同学。而你——

lines.en: : What about...other options? Like...maybe if I just load up on every one of my medications before going over to his place the next time, I can just ignore-
lines.zh: : 那……别的选择呢？比如……下次去他家之前，把我所有的药都先吃个够，这样我就能直接忽略——

lines.en: scene proxy25
: You can’t just throw medication at all of your problems. That’s unhealthy and you know it.
lines.zh: : 你不能什么都靠吃药解决。那样不健康，你自己也清楚。

lines.en: : Then what? Do I just...find someone else to rely on? Someone more like me who can live without that sort of thing?
lines.zh: : 那怎么办？我就……去找个别的能依靠的人？一个更像我、没有那种需求也能活的人？

lines.en: : Like, yeah. That seems pretty reasonable on paper. A great idea even. But will Io-brain agree? I think not. Io-brain wants Sensei. She just wants a Sensei that doesn’t get a boner every five minutes.
lines.zh: : 是啊，理论上听起来挺合理的。甚至是个好主意。可 Io 脑会答应吗？我看不会。Io 脑想要老师。她只是想要一个不会每五分钟就勃起一次的老师。

lines.en: : Io...I don’t really know how to give you advice for something I’ve never experienced before...so I’m going to just speak generally and you can take from that what you will.
lines.zh: : Io……我从来没经历过这种事，真不知道该怎么给你建议……所以我只能说些笼统的话，你能吸收多少算多少。

lines.en: scene proxy26
: I don’t think that charging your biggest fears face first is something that works for people like us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，迎面冲向你最深的恐惧，对我们这种人是不管用的。

lines.en: : I think that...the things we have gone through make us a lot more fragile. And so we need to be a lot more careful when it comes to facing our fears so the duct tape holding us together doesn’t come off.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我们经历过的那些事，让我们比别人脆弱得多。所以面对恐惧时，我们得更小心，才能不让那层把我们粘在一起的胶带脱落。

lines.en: : Cause even if we do our best to hide it and pretend it isn’t there, we’ll never be as {i}together{/i} as all of the other girls...the ones who haven’t been...chipped away at yet.
lines.zh: : 因为就算我们再怎么努力遮掩、装作它不存在，我们也永远不可能像其他那些女孩一样{i}完整{/i}——那些还没有被……一点点削掉过的女孩。

lines.en: : So...it’s okay that I’m not forcing myself? It’s okay to do what {i}I{/i} want rather than what Sensei wants? Even if it puts our relationship at risk?
lines.zh: : 所以……我不逼自己也没关系？我可以做{i}我{/i}想做的，而不是老师想做的？哪怕这会让我们的关系陷入危险？

lines.en: scene proxy27
: I think so.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可以。

lines.en: : Sensei might be a pervert who needs sex in order to survive, but I doubt he’d cast you aside just because you’re not open to it.
lines.zh: : 老师也许是个离了性就活不下去的变态，但我不认为他会因为你接受不了就把你推开。

lines.en: : That’s a relief. Sure, there’s the inherent risk that you’re misinterpreting who he is as a person and that the exact opposite of what you just said may happen...but still. That’s a relief.
lines.zh: : 这我就放心了。当然，其中也固有这么个风险：你可能把他这个人理解错了，你刚才说的反过来也完全可能发生……但即便如此。我还是放心了。

lines.en: : I wish there was something I could do for him...
lines.zh: : 我真希望我能为他做点什么……

lines.en: : I just {i}can’t.{/i} You know?
lines.zh: : 可我就是{i}做不到{/i}。你懂吧？

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我懂。

lines.en: scene proxy28
: If only you liked Sensei too. That would solve pretty much everything.
lines.zh: : 要是你也喜欢老师就好了。那基本就能解决所有问题了。

lines.en: : Uh.......what?
scene proxy29
: Yeah! You’re not averse to sex the way I am. So if you also liked him, he could get all of his sexual energy out on you and I’d never have to worry about doing that sort of thing with him.
lines.zh: : 对啊！你又不像我这样排斥性。所以如果你也喜欢他，他就能把那些性方面的精力全发泄在你身上，我就永远不用操心跟他做那种事了。

lines.en: : Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta？

lines.en: : Are you out of your fucking mind?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是不是疯了？

lines.en: scene proxy30
: Yes. That’s like, my whole thing.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这基本就是我的设定。

lines.en: : But...But you’ve never...said anything about...{i}sharing{/i} him before...
lines.zh: : 可……可你从来没说过什么……跟他{i}共享{/i}之类的……

lines.en: scene proxy31
: Really? I could have sworn I mentioned something about the two of you getting together at one point. I just figured you weren’t interested.
lines.zh: : 有吗？我明明记得我提过一嘴，说你们俩可以在一起。我只是以为你没兴趣。

lines.en: : In a perfect world, which obviously doesn’t exist, the ideal scenario would just be him and a trauma-less Io together. But there are loads of problems with that and it would never work.
lines.zh: : 在完美世界里——显然这种世界并不存在——最理想的情形，就是他和一个没有创伤的 Io 在一起。可那里面有太多问题，根本行不通。

lines.en: : I can’t provide what Sensei needs in a relationship and, frankly, if he was with me every single day, he’d get tired and fed up after like, a week.
lines.zh: : 老师在一段关系里需要的东西，我给不了；而且说实话，要是他天天跟我在一起，大概一周就腻了、烦了。

lines.en: : By that logic, having someone else come in to provide what I can’t, namely someone I also love, IE: you...is not just the quickest path to a future where I can be happy with him, but the {i}only{/i} path.
lines.zh: : 按这个逻辑，让另一个人来补上我给不了的部分——而且那个人还是我同样爱着的人，也就是：你——不只是我能和他拥有幸福未来的最快路径，而是{i}唯一{/i}的路径。

lines.en: : The only issue is that that wouldn’t make {i}you{/i} happy. And I could never ask you to be my sex proxy if you’re not into the same guy as me.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，那样的话{i}你{/i}不会幸福。而且我绝不可能让你去当我的性替身——如果喜欢上的不是同一个男人的话。

lines.en: : Does that make more sense?
lines.zh: : 这么说好懂点了吗？

lines.en: scene proxy32
: No?
lines.zh: : 没有？

lines.en: : {i}Sex proxy?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}性替身？{/i}

lines.en: : So...what? My job would be to lay there and have sex with him while you two do all of the fun, cute, couple stuff together?
lines.zh: : 所以……怎样？我的工作就是躺在那儿跟他上床，而你们俩去做所有好玩又甜蜜的情侣活动？

lines.en: : Of course not. All three of us could do fun couple stuff together. But we could also get private time whenever we want it. The big thing is that you’d be the only one he actually has sex with. And I’d just be Io.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。三个人可以一起做那些甜蜜的情侣活动。但谁想要私人时间也随时能有。重点是，你会是唯一一个真正跟他发生性关系的人。而我就只是 Io。

lines.en: scene proxy33
: Oh my God. You want a fucking throuple.
lines.zh: : 我的天。你想要一段他妈的三人行。

lines.en: : Oh, is there a name for it? Cool.
lines.zh: : 哦，这还有专门的叫法吗？不错。

lines.en: : It would really only work with you, though. The idea of Sensei with anyone else makes me want to puke.
lines.zh: : 不过这事儿只跟你才行。想到老师跟别的任何人在一起，我都想吐。

lines.en: : But I don’t put you in the same bracket as everyone else. You’re an essential part of my life and, in many ways, the glue that holds me together. The hinges to my door.
lines.zh: : 但我不会把你和别人归为一类。你是我生命中不可或缺的一部分，在很多意义上，是把粘在一起的胶水。是我这扇门上的合页。

lines.en: : Plus, the two of us falling for the same guy would eliminate the risk of you ever dating someone I {i}don’t{/i} like and trying to drag them into the group. I really don’t see any downsides.
lines.zh: : 而且，我们俩爱上同一个男人，就能避免你哪天带个我{i}不喜欢{/i}的人回来谈恋爱、还想把他拉进我们的圈子。我真看不出有什么坏处。

lines.en: : Well, other than the fact that you don’t like him and I would never force you to do something like that for my sake alone.
lines.zh: : 除了一个：你不喜欢他，而我永远不会为了我自己就逼你去做那种事。

lines.en: : This is a dream. Any second now, I’m going to wake up.
lines.zh: : 这是一场梦。再过一秒，我就会醒过来。

lines.en: : Heeeeey! Uta! Io!
lines.zh: : 嘿——！Uta！Io！

scene proxy34
: Oh, Generic Blonde #17. What are you doing out here?
lines.zh: : 哦，泛用金发女郎 17 号。你跑出来干什么？

lines.en: : Why do you know so many blondes?
lines.zh: : 你为什么认识那么多金发女郎？

lines.zh: : 我也不知道，但我真希望自己不认识。你想要什么？

lines.en: : We’re about to start Secret Santa and Imani told me you guys went out here to talk. Is everything alright with Uta? She looks...shocked.
lines.zh: : 我们准备开始 Secret Santa 了，Imani 说你们俩跑到这儿来聊天。Uta 还好吗？她看起来……受惊了。

lines.en: scene proxy35
: Yeah, she’s been acting kind of weird for a few minutes now. But it’s in response to something I have no intention of repeating to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她已经怪了好几分钟了。不过那是在回应某些我完全没打算跟你复述的话。

lines.en: : Any minute now...I will wake up in my bed...and none of this will have ever happened...
lines.zh: : 再过一会儿……我就会在自己的床上醒过来……这一切就都没发生过了……

lines.en: : Should we pinch her?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要掐她一下？

lines.en: : She’ll be fine. She just needs a few minutes to try and reword the apparently horrible explanation I just gave about my feelings. But again, not for you.
lines.zh: : 她没事的。她只是需要几分钟，试着把我刚才那番关于自己感情的解释——显然讲得很糟糕——换个说法。但再说一遍，不关你的事。

lines.en: : Right...
: Well, come with me, I guess. We can’t start until everyone is there and you’re the last two hold-outs apart from Otoha.
lines.zh: : 那，跟我走吧。人都到齐了才能开始，除了 Otoha，就剩你们两个还没到。

lines.zh: : 你走得了吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

: We’ll be there in a minute.
lines.zh: : 我们马上就过去。
